title: National Biodiversity Authority Releases ₹15.52 Crore ABS Proceeds from Mustard Genetic Resources
summary: National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) released ₹15.52 crore Access and Benefit Sharing proceeds from mustard genetic resources.

blocks.content: National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) released ₹15.52 crore Access and Benefit Sharing proceeds from mustard genetic resources.

items: **ABS Disbursement:** Released **₹15.52 crore** in Access and Benefit Sharing (ABS) proceeds.
**NBA Profile:** Statutory body established Oct 1, 2003 under Biological Diversity Act 2002 (MoEFCC). HQ: **Chennai, Tamil Nadu**.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: ≠ **HQ Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu (NOT New Delhi).
